title: Advanced
infotainment: 14.5-inch touchscreen + 12.3-inch digital cluster, Genesis Connected Car, navigation, B&O 16-speaker premium audio, OTA updates.
adasStandard: Full Genesis ADAS suite: FCA2 (pedestrian/cyclist/junction), SCC w/ Stop & Go, Lane Keeping/Following Assist, Blind-Spot Collision Avoidance, Rear Cross-Traffic Collision Avoidance, Driver Attention Warning, Safe Exit Assist, Highway Driving Assist 2, Remote Smart Parking Assist 2, Surround-View Monitor, Blind-Spot View Monitor. Boost Mode (483 hp / 3.8 sec 0-60). Source: [Edmunds 2025 Electrified GV70 Advanced](https://www.edmunds.com/genesis/electrified-gv70/2025/st-402036051/features-specs/).
adasOptional: No additional ADAS — full suite standard.
rearViewCameraNotes: Rear-view camera with dynamic guidelines plus Surround-View Monitor 360° standard.
sideViewCameraNotes: Surround-View Monitor 360° + Blind-Spot View Monitor side-camera feeds in instrument cluster. Same camera tier as GV60 Advanced.
subscriptionFeatures: GCS complimentary on 2023+ MY then paid. No feature-gated subscriptions.
drmNotes: Core functions offline. GCS 4G LTE for remote app, OTA, SOS, real-time traffic. Same connectivity profile as GV60.
knownIssues: ICCU failures on E-GMP platform — same campaign 245 software fix and extended warranty applies to Electrified GV70. Source: [NHTSA](https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls).
recalls: No active 2025 Electrified GV70 safety recalls May 2026. Source: [NHTSA](https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls).
stateIncentives: Built at HMMA Alabama, became IRA-eligible Jan 2025; full $7,500 federal credit available for purchases placed in service through Sept 30, 2025 ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2025/01/02/hyundai-kia-evs-qualify-7500-tax-credit-first-time/)). Many states stack additional incentives: CO $5k EV credit, CA/IL/NJ rebates per [DSIRE](https://www.dsireusa.org/).

stateIncentives: Same as Advanced — full $7,500 IRA credit through Sept 30, 2025. State stacking available. See [DSIRE](https://www.dsireusa.org/).

title: Standard AWD
infotainment: 12.3-inch touchscreen + 12.3-inch digital cluster, Genesis Connected Car, B&O 17-speaker standard, navigation, OTA updates.
adasStandard: Full Genesis ADAS suite: FCA2 (pedestrian/cyclist/junction), SCC with Stop & Go, Lane Keeping/Following Assist, Blind-Spot Collision Avoidance, Rear Cross-Traffic Collision Avoidance, Driver Attention Warning, Safe Exit Assist, Highway Driving Assist 2, Remote Smart Parking Assist. Sources: [Edmunds 2025 GV60 Standard AWD](https://www.edmunds.com/genesis/gv60/2025/st-402045484/features-specs/).
adasOptional: No additional ADAS — full suite standard.
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard rear-view camera with dynamic guidelines. Surround-View Monitor (360°) is Performance-trim only; Standard AWD is single-rear-camera. Source: [Edmunds 2025 GV60 Standard AWD](https://www.edmunds.com/genesis/gv60/2025/st-402045484/features-specs/).
sideViewCameraNotes: Blind-Spot View Monitor — turn-signal-triggered side camera feed in instrument cluster (both sides, LaneWatch-style). No Surround-View Monitor on this trim. Source: [Edmunds 2025 GV60](https://www.edmunds.com/genesis/gv60/2025/features-specs/).
subscriptionFeatures: Genesis Connected Services complimentary on 2023+ MY then paid. No feature-gated subscriptions (heated seats, ADAS not paywalled).
drmNotes: Same connectivity profile as Standard RWD — core functions offline-capable; remote/OTA features require GCS subscription. See [MyGenesis Connected Services](https://owners.genesis.com/us/en/page/connected-services.html).
killSwitchNotes: No impaired-driving disablement. Driver Attention Warning warns only.
knownIssues: ICCU failures on E-GMP platform — small number of incidents, software update + extended warranty issued by Hyundai Motor Group.
recalls: No active GV60-specific safety recalls May 2026. Source: [NHTSA](https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls).
stateIncentives: See Standard RWD entry. Standard AWD exceeds the MA MOR-EV $55k cap by $850 — not eligible. CO $5k credit still applies. Verify on [DSIRE](https://www.dsireusa.org/).

title: Standard RWD
infotainment: 12.3-inch touchscreen + 12.3-inch digital cluster, Genesis Connected Car system with OTA updates, navigation, Bang & Olufsen 17-speaker premium audio standard.
adasStandard: Forward Collision-Avoidance Assist 2 (pedestrian, cyclist, junction-turning), Smart Cruise Control with Stop & Go, Lane Keeping Assist, Lane Following Assist, Blind-Spot Collision-Avoidance Assist, Rear Cross-Traffic Collision-Avoidance Assist, Driver Attention Warning, Safe Exit Assist, Highway Driving Assist 2 (lane-centering + auto lane change on highways). Sources: [Edmunds 2025 GV60 Standard](https://www.edmunds.com/genesis/gv60/2025/st-402045483/features-specs/), [JD Power HDA2](https://www.jdpower.com/cars/shopping-guides/what-is-hyundai-highway-driving-assist-2).
adasOptional: No additional ADAS available on Standard trim — Genesis bundles full ADAS suite as standard across all GV60 trims.
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard rear-view camera with dynamic guidelines (turn-coordinated). Resolution not published — appears HD-class. Multi-angle reverse view available via Surround-View Monitor on higher trims; Standard trim is single-camera rear-only ([Edmunds 2025 GV60 Standard](https://www.edmunds.com/genesis/gv60/2025/st-402045483/features-specs/)).
sideViewCameraNotes: Side-mirror Blind-Spot View Monitor (BVM) — when turn signal activated, the corresponding side camera feed displays in the digital instrument cluster (Honda LaneWatch-style, both sides). Not Surround-View Monitor on the base Standard trim — SVM 360 is a Performance-only feature. Source: [Edmunds 2025 GV60](https://www.edmunds.com/genesis/gv60/2025/features-specs/).
subscriptionFeatures: Genesis Connected Services (Connected Care, Remote, Guidance bundles) — complimentary period on 2023+ MY then transitions to paid. Renewal pricing not publicly disclosed — historically ~$99-179/year per bundle. No heated-seat or ADAS subscription gating on Genesis MY25/MY26 (unlike BMW's reversed-course experiments). Navigation map updates included for 3 years. Source: [Genesis Connected Services](https://owners.genesis.com/us/en/page/connected-services.html).
drmNotes: Core driving, climate, audio, and physical-key entry work fully offline. Genesis Connected Services (4G LTE) is required for: remote start via app, remote climate, remote door lock, automatic collision notification, SOS, geofencing, real-time traffic in navigation, OTA software updates. GCS is complimentary on 2023+ MY for an unspecified initial term; lapses revert to non-subscription state without disabling base car. Wireless network shutdowns (3G precedent) can permanently strand telematics features. Source: [MyGenesis Connected Services T&C](https://owners.genesis.com/us/en/terms-and-conditions.html).
killSwitchNotes: No impaired-driving disablement system. Driver Attention Warning is camera + steering-input based fatigue detection only — warns the driver, never disables vehicle operation. Federal IIJA Section 24220 rule not yet finalized as of May 2026 ([KBB](https://www.kbb.com/car-news/nhtsas-new-kill-switch-law-approaches-key-deadline/)).
knownIssues: Reported ICCU (Integrated Charging Control Unit) failures on E-GMP platform siblings (Ioniq 5, EV6) have extended to a small number of GV60 units, causing 12V battery drain and no-start condition. Hyundai Motor Group issued a software update (campaign 245) and extended ICCU warranty to 10yr/100k mi. Source: [HMG service campaign](https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls).
recalls: No active GV60-specific recalls open as of May 2026. ICCU update campaign 245 is an extended-warranty service action, not a safety recall. Source: [NHTSA Recalls — Genesis](https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls).
stateIncentives: Varies by state. CA CVRP closed Nov 2023 (not currently eligible). CO offers $5k state EV tax credit through 2026 ($3.5k 2027+). NJ exempts EVs from sales tax. NY Drive Clean Rebate up to $2k for EVs under $42k MSRP — GV60 does not qualify (over cap). MA MOR-EV up to $3,500 for EVs under $55k — Standard RWD qualifies. Verify current eligibility on [DSIRE](https://www.dsireusa.org/).
